summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Event Management File Upload System. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend file upload components functional with successful event creation.
critical_code_review_comments: AWS S3 uploads are MOCKED - using local file storage at /app/uploads instead. For production, AWS credentials need to be configured.
The frontend uses VITE_API_URL environment variable correctly for API calls
File upload component (FileUpload.tsx) is well-implemented with proper error handling and preview functionality
seed_data_creation: Created 4 test events with file uploads via API and UI testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: File upload system fully functional. Backend uses local storage fallback since AWS S3 credentials not configured. All upload endpoints (/api/upload/single, /api/upload/multiple) working. Events can be created with file URLs stored in MongoDB.
